description: This file sets up a SOAP web service for vtiger CRM, registering multiple functions for creating and managing CRM entities such as leads, contacts, accounts, tickets, vendors, products, notes, sites, RSS feeds, and handling permissions and sessions.

classes.name: soap_server
classes.description: SOAP server object used to register web service functions and handle requests.

methods.name: CheckLeadPermission
methods.description: Checks if the user has permission to edit leads.

methods.name: CheckContactPermission
methods.description: Checks if the user has permission to edit contacts.

methods.name: CheckAccountPermission
methods.description: Checks if the user has permission to edit accounts.

methods.name: CheckTicketPermission
methods.description: Checks if the user has permission to edit help desk tickets.

methods.name: CheckVendorPermission
methods.description: Checks if the user has permission to edit vendors.

methods.name: CheckProductPermission
methods.description: Checks if the user has permission to edit products.

methods.name: CheckNotePermission
methods.description: Checks if the user has permission to edit documents/notes.

methods.name: CheckSitePermission
methods.description: Checks if the user has permission to edit portal sites.

methods.name: CheckRssPermission
methods.description: Checks if the user has permission to edit RSS feeds.

methods.name: create_site_from_webform
methods.description: Creates a new portal site from web form input.

methods.name: LogintoVtigerCRM
methods.description: Authenticates user and creates a session in vtiger CRM.

methods.name: create_rss_from_webform
methods.description: Creates a new RSS feed entry from web form input.

methods.name: create_note_from_webform
methods.description: Creates a new document/note from web form input.

methods.name: create_product_from_webform
methods.description: Creates a new product from web form input.

methods.name: create_vendor_from_webform
methods.description: Creates a new vendor from web form input.

methods.name: create_ticket_from_toolbar
methods.description: Creates a new help desk ticket from toolbar input.

methods.name: create_account
methods.description: Creates a new account record.

methods.name: create_lead_from_webform
methods.description: Creates a new lead record from web form input.

methods.name: create_contacts
methods.description: Creates a new contact record.

methods.name: create_contact1
methods.description: Helper function to create a contact with detailed parameters.

methods.name: GetPicklistValues
methods.description: Retrieves picklist values for a specified table.

methods.name: unsetServerSessionId
methods.description: Removes session record for a user.

methods.name: validateSession
methods.description: Validates user session based on session ID.

methods.name: getServerSessionId
methods.description: Retrieves session ID for a user from database.
